summary.en: In an earthquake, falling furniture, falling objects and broken glass can hurt you. Fix furniture to the wall, and do not put tall furniture near where you sleep. Keep your escape route clear. There are also seismic breakers that cut the power in strong shaking. In a rented room, ask the landlord or agent before making holes in the walls.
